step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Imagers
step1_figure.description: An NMOS-input delta-sigma modulator circuit designed for column-parallel sensing in CMOS image sensors. It employs switched-capacitor current integration with PMOS cup capacitors and NMOS bucket capacitors, feeding a dynamic latching comparator and NOR-based SR latch to digitize the difference between reference and pixel intensity voltages.

shifted_reference_voltage.description: Effective reference voltage after shifting by the NMOS threshold voltage

equation.explanation: The effective drive voltage converted to current through the reference input branch is shifted down by one NMOS threshold drop.
equation.assumptions: NMOS source follower operates with body effect / source near ground potential.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For V_R = 650 mV and typical SKY130 NMOS Vth of ~0.42 V, the shifted reference is approximately 230 mV.

shifted_signal_voltage.description: Effective pixel intensity signal voltage after shifting by NMOS threshold voltage

equation.explanation: The intensity voltage converted to current through the signal input branch is shifted by one threshold drop.
equation.assumptions: Identical NMOS device threshold on signal and reference branches.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For V_I = 600 mV and V_THN = 0.42 V, the shifted signal level is 180 mV.

voltage_resolution.description: Quantization resolution of the sensing circuit over N clock cycles

equation.explanation: The minimum detectable voltage step is given by the full-scale shifted reference divided by the total number of conversion clock cycles N.
equation.assumptions: N = 100 clock cycles over the 1 us measurement window.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With 100 clock periods during sensing and V_R,shift = 230 mV, each count step corresponds to ~2.3 mV.

switched_cap_resistance.description: Effective resistance of the switched-capacitor cup resistor

equation.explanation: The equivalent switched-capacitor resistance that sets the current integration rate.
equation.assumptions: f = 100 MHz (clock period T = 10 ns), C_cup ~ 100 fF implemented with PMOS in inversion.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Switched-capacitor equivalent resistance operating at 100 MHz clock.

modulator_output_duty_cycle.description: Fraction of clock cycles that the feedback signal Q is enabled during sensing

equation.explanation: In balance, the average charge fed back from the reference branch matches that injected from the intensity branch, so the Q duty ratio equals V_I,shift / V_R,shift.
equation.assumptions: Modulator is in steady-state tracking over the 500 ns to 1500 ns window.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For V_I = 600 mV and V_R = 650 mV, Q is asserted ~78% of cycles; average voltage reflects this duty cycle.

average_power.description: Total average power consumed by the DSM sensing circuit during active conversion

source.reference: Section 17.2 text on sensing circuit operation

equation.explanation: Average dynamic and static power consumed during the 1 us sensing window.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_avg ~ 100 uA => P_avg = 1.8 V * 100 uA = 180 uW
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by dynamic charging of bucket/cup capacitors and comparator switching.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation testbench for the DSM sensing circuit measuring output duty ratio, shifted signal/reference voltages, resolution, and power over 100 clock cycles (500 ns to 1500 ns).
